hero.title: FAQ pattern
hero.description: Use native `<details>/<summary>` for FAQ and expandable public content by default.

flat.title: Example — flat mode
flat.description: A single card holding one flat list of questions.

items.question: Why use native details/summary?
items.answer: It removes JS/hydration dependency for basic disclosure behavior and improves no-JS resilience.

items.question: What should be checked after migration?
items.answer: Expand/collapse behavior in JS browsers, no-JS readability, and visual spacing consistency.

items.question: When is a custom accordion acceptable?
items.answer: Avoid it for public FAQ/disclosure content unless there is a documented, reviewed exception.

sectioned.title: Sectioned mode
sectioned.description: One titled card per section, for longer FAQ pages grouped by topic.

items.question: What is this organization?
items.answer: A volunteer-led community rescue group focused on feeding, rescuing, and rehoming stray animals.

items.question: What area do you serve?
items.answer: We primarily serve the local community and surrounding areas. Contact us for out-of-area resources.

items.question: How do I adopt?
items.answer: Submit an application on the Adoption page. Our team reviews applications and follows up on potential matches.

items.question: Is there an adoption fee?
items.answer: Yes. Fees help offset vaccinations, spay/neuter surgery, and medical care costs.

items.question: How can I volunteer?
items.answer: Visit our Volunteer page or contact us directly. No prior experience is required.

standard.title: Standard
items: Preferred for FAQ, informational disclosures, and "learn more" content.
Must work without JavaScript or hydration — content stays readable and expandable with JS off.
Style directly in the page/pattern component; do not require a JS accordion wrapper.
Use a custom accordion only with a documented exception.
Verify keyboard support (Enter/Space on summary) and focus visibility.
